summary: A repo-wide docstring ratchet fails when new test functions have no docstring
root_cause: tests/test_gate.py caps functions without docstrings, so five new tests pushed the count over
rule: Give every new test function a one-line docstring before the full run

summary: An open story file .story-gate/.active makes TestStartBranch fail locally
root_cause: The test copies the working tree, and the active-story marker is untracked state
rule: Move .story-gate/.active aside when running the full suite locally; CI has none
